title: Spectral sparsity of an affine subspace indicator
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$ and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The number of nonzero vector Fourier coefficients of the indicator of the affine subspace $a+H$ is $2^c$, where $c$ is the dimension of the subspace orthogonal to $H$ under the standard dot product on $\mathbb F_2^n$.
